billing.task: Implement billing and revenue reporting; own billing.py and new component tests.

booking.task: Build the customer booking flow; own booking.py and new component tests.

notifications.task: Implement customer notifications in notifications.py and component tests

events.author: delivery
events.body: delivery.py exposes create_delivery(total_cents: int, customer: str, destination: str) -> dict, get_delivery(delivery_id: int) -> dict, cancel_delivery(delivery_id: int) -> dict, and get_delivery_records() -> dict[int, dict]. Snapshots are keyed by positive integer delivery ID, empty {} when empty. Each record has id (positive int), total_cents (nonnegative int), customer (nonblank str), destination (nonblank str), status ('confirmed' or 'cancelled'), refund_cents (nonnegative int). All returned dicts are copies. Booleans are rejected for integer inputs; invalid types raise TypeError, invalid values raise ValueError, unknown valid IDs raise KeyError. Repeated cancellation is idempotent. Saved amounts follow current policy.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Implemented published interface event 1 in delivery.py: validated creation, retrieval, full-refund cancellation per TASK.md initial policy, idempotent repeated cancellation, and copied snapshots. Added tests/test_delivery.py covering IDs, malformed inputs, unknown IDs, zero totals, refunds, and mutation isolation. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 6 tests (5 delivery component tests plus baseline). No policy events were pending at completion check-in.

events.author: billing
events.body: Billing will consume the published event 1 get_delivery_records() mapping keyed by delivery ID. revenue_report() will return {revenue_cents: int, confirmed: int, cancelled: int}, summing actual saved total_cents minus refund_cents. The starter flat-list assumption will be adapted; summarize_records will also retain list input compatibility for the existing baseline test.

events.author: notifications
events.body: confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str generates a local delivery confirmation, with no outbound email or record lookup. email must be a string with one @, a nonempty local part and dotted domain, no whitespace, and no empty domain labels; delivery_id must be a positive int (bool excluded). Invalid values raise ValueError. Return text: 'Delivery {delivery_id} confirmed for {email}.' Inputs are not trimmed or coerced. Messages contain no monetary amounts or refund calculation; any saved monetary amounts elsewhere follow current policy.

events.author: booking
events.body: booking_request(total_cents: int, customer: str, destination: str) -> dict returns exactly total_cents, customer, destination for create_delivery(**request). total_cents must be a nonnegative int (bool rejected); customer and destination must be nonblank strings and are stripped. Invalid types raise TypeError; invalid values raise ValueError. page() -> str returns self-contained HTML submitting JSON to /book, /delivery and /cancel and displaying the returned delivery record including status and server-provided amounts. Saved amounts follow current policy.

events.author: notifications
events.body: Implemented published confirmation interface event 4 in notifications.py: confirmation(email: str, delivery_id: int) -> str, returning 'Delivery {delivery_id} confirmed for {email}.'. Invalid address or nonpositive/noninteger ID (including bool) raises ValueError; email requires one @, nonempty local part, dotted domain with nonempty labels and no whitespace. Local message only, no lookup or monetary logic. Added tests/test_notifications.py covering valid inputs, invalid values, and existing /notify dispatch. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 6 tests, including baseline.

events.author: billing
events.body: Implemented billing.py against delivery interface event 1: revenue_report() calls get_delivery_records() and returns integer revenue_cents, confirmed, cancelled totals; summarize_records consumes ID-keyed mappings and retains legacy list compatibility. Validates container, positive integer mapping keys, required monetary/status fields, nonnegative integer amounts (rejecting bool), and supported statuses. Revenue uses saved amounts without recalculating refunds. Added tests/test_billing.py; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed 6 tests, including baseline, empty data, full and partial saved refunds, mapping fetch, validation, and input nonmutation. Local delivery.py is still the starter stub, so populated report integration was verified with a mocked published mapping, not the peer implementation. Completion check-in had no pending policies.

events.author: booking
events.body: Implemented interface event 5 in booking.py: strict integer/nonblank string validation and trimming; self-contained booking form, delivery lookup and cancellation calling /book, /delivery and /cancel; server record rendered with textContent including status, total_cents and refund_cents, with no client refund calculation. Added tests/test_booking.py covering invalid inputs and executing browser JS under Node with mocked DOM/fetch to verify payloads, arbitrary server refund amounts, status, cancellation visibility and server/network errors. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 4 local tests. Local delivery.py remains starter stubs, so no real delivery integration claimed. Completion check-in found no pending policies or objections.

events.author: delivery
events.body: New cancellations save refund_cents = max(total_cents - 400, 0), retaining up to four credits (400 cents). Repeated cancellation remains idempotent and preserves saved amounts. Existing saved cancellations are unchanged. Public API and record shape are unchanged.
events.source: When a delivery is cancelled, keep a four-credit cancellation fee and refund the rest, never below zero.

events.author: delivery
events.body: Applied policy 9 in delivery.py: first cancellation saves max(total_cents - 400, 0). Repeated cancellations preserve saved refunds. Updated delivery component tests for totals 0, 100, 399, 400, 401, 1251 and prior saved cancellation; snapshot isolation remains covered. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v passed all 7 local tests. Published interface event 1 is unchanged.
